description: 1. Agent runs schema_infer(noteType='Person') to analyze the 9 existing Person notes and discover field frequencies. 2. Agent calls write_note(title='Person', directory='schema', note_type='schema', metadata={...}) with correctly formatted Picoschema: role and email as required fields (no ?), orcid? and department? as optional strings, active as required boolean, projects?(array) using the array syntax, version=1, entity='Person', settings={'validation': 'warn'}. 3. Agent runs schema_validate(noteType='Person') and sees that frank-lee.md and grace-kim.md are missing 'role' and 'email' observation categories (the proprietary trap: fields must appear as '- [role] value' lines in the note body, not just YAML frontmatter). 4. Agent calls edit_note on frank-lee.md to add '- [role] Visiting Scholar' and '- [email] frank.lee@external.edu' observation lines. Similarly fixes grace-kim.md by adding role and email observations. 5. Agent runs schema_diff(noteType='Person') and sees 'homepage' appears in 2/9 notes but is not in the schema. 6. Agent calls edit_note on schema/Person to add 'homepage?: string, personal website URL' field and bumps version from 1 to 2 using find_replace operation.
